platform_info.name: ActivityWatch
platform_info.description: Handles ActivityWatch JSON exports from Windows, macOS, and Android devices. Participants upload their exported JSON file directly.

description.en: Periods when you were away from (or returned to) your keyboard, as recorded by ActivityWatch.
description.nl: Perioden waarin u weg was van (of terugkeerde naar) uw toetsenbord, zoals geregistreerd door ActivityWatch.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one AFK (away-from-keyboard) event, recording when the participant was idle or active at their device.
documentation.source_file: the uploaded JSON file — buckets with type containing 'afk'

columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of the start of the AFK event.
columns.Duration (s): Duration of the event in seconds.

description.en: Active application and window events as recorded by ActivityWatch. Window titles are hashed for privacy. To remove a specific application from your donation: search for it in the table, click the top result, then click the delete button.
description.nl: Actieve applicatie- en venstergebeurtenissen zoals geregistreerd door ActivityWatch. Venstertitels zijn gehasht voor privacy. Om een specifieke applicatie uit uw donatie te verwijderen: zoek ernaar in de tabel, klik op het bovenste resultaat en klik op de verwijderknop.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one window-focus or app-usage event. Window titles are hashed for privacy. Additional data fields (url, package, classname) are included when present.
documentation.source_file: the uploaded JSON file — buckets with type containing 'currentwindow'

columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of the start of the event.
columns.Duration (s): Duration of the event in seconds.
columns.Title Hash: Salted SHA-256 hash (16 hex chars) of the window title.

description.en: Timestamps of screen unlocks, typically from Android devices running ActivityWatch.
description.nl: Tijdstippen van schermontgrendelingen, meestal van Android-apparaten met ActivityWatch.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one screen-unlock event, typically from an Android device.
documentation.source_file: the uploaded JSON file — buckets with type containing 'unlock'

columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of the unlock event.
